entities.summary: The Lubin Historical Museum is a local museum in the town of Lubin, Poland. It presents, in particular, Lubin's recent history. It is a local government cultural institution, established in 2016, and opened to the public on 17 May 2018. It is located in the historic town hall and in the Forest Park
